# toHorizontalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`HorizontalAlignmentInput`](horizontal-alignment-input.md) to the [`HorizontalAlignment`](horizontal-alignment.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toHorizontalAlignment(input: HorizontalAlignment | HorizontalAlignmentToken): HorizontalAlignment
```
